An inspiration mentor appears teaching Pink intrinsic motivation principles: people motivated by autonomy (self-direction craving), mastery (growth-desire), and purpose (meaning-seeking)—identify intrinsic drivers matching tasks accordingly, create environment supporting autonomy enabling self-actualization, external rewards insufficient but internal drives powerful.
